title: filter_by regression with unioned etc. queries

labels.name: regression
labels.description: something worked and was broken by a change

body:
### Describe the bug

the new logic for filter_by doesn't work if the query is adapting to a subquery like a union

### To Reproduce

```python
from sqlalchemy import BigInteger
from sqlalchemy import Column
from sqlalchemy.ext.declarative import declarative_base
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

Base = declarative_base()


class Share(Base):
    __tablename__ = "shares"
    id = Column(BigInteger, primary_key=True)



session = Session()

first = session.query(Share)
second = session.query(Share)
union = first.union(second)

print(union.filter(Share.id == 1))
print(union.filter_by(id=1))
```
